description: Multi-repo worktrees for coding agents: one feature across repos, as one unit, with one branch, one plan and one pull request per repo.
rules: A hall is a git repo that declares team repositories in ivar.json
Repos not promoted into a feature are guarded; the guard is kernel-enforced only on Linux, for agents launched by ivar session start
Supported providers are Claude Code, OpenCode and OMP; Codex is not a provider
Opening pull requests requires GitHub and the gh CLI
